blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police launched a manhunt for three individuals who duped a 72-year-old retired government employee to hand in jewelry and other valuables worth about P100,000 in a “budol-budol” (swindling) scheme. This crime happened at a local shopping center in Tandag City, Surigao del Sur on Tuesday, Oct. 6. Col. Jeffrey Lawrence D. Mauricio, director of the Surigao del Sur Police Provincial Office, said investigators from the Tandag Component City Police Station are tracking down a male suspect and two female accomplices. The three perpetrators allegedly targeted the victim at Prince Town Tandag in Barangay Bag-ong Lungsod. […]...
